name: Adam Hamawy
summary:
Adam Hisham Hamawy (ٱدم هشام حموي; born 1969/1970) is an American plastic surgeon and former U.S. Army physician who is the member-elect for New Jersey's 12th congressional district. Hamawy specializes in both cosmetic and reconstructive procedures at his practice in Princeton, New Jersey.
Hamawy gained national attention in 2024 as part of a volunteer team of American doctors in Gaza who were unable to leave after Israel seized and closed the Rafah border crossing during the Gaza war.
